release_policy: No package may be released with blocking validation failures.

rules.name: Every included detected scope has a located section
Every picked section exists in the CSI 2026 inventory
Every master activity barcode resolves to one inventory item
Every estimate scope has schedule coverage or an approved no-schedule exception
Every scheduled scope has estimate coverage or an approved no-cost exception
Every activity duration is calculated, user-set, or explicitly pending review
Every activity has an applicable working calendar
Holiday treatment references the stored 20-year holiday calendar
Union, non-union, mixed, PLA, and wage rules are confirmed or flagged
Weather-sensitive activities reference an approved Weather Center profile
Earthquake and location hazard profiles are linked when applicable
Required inspections, tests, submittals, procurement, safety, training, commissioning and closeout are covered
No excluded or unsupported inventory item was silently added
Low-confidence detections and document conflicts are in the review queue
Every released item traces to source evidence and its master barcode
No source document or master inventory record was modified during assembly
